Subject: Project "Customer Loyalty Program" Update Q4 2023

Dear Team,

I want to provide our most recent insights and outlook concerning the “Customer Loyalty Program” development for Q4 2023.
As of last week, we finished developing the basic functionalities and user interface (UI) components, allowing internal testing for usability. 

Over the next three weeks, we will:
1. Continue thorough beta testing among key user groups (2nd week) 
2. Iterate design refinements based on feedback (3rd week) 
3. Perform performance optimizations before go-live (4th week)

A crucial point in this finalization involves getting clear language consent between product teams, as certain wording on sign-up screens could impact privacy and T+Cs interpretations by legal compliance, affecting marketing strategies for 2024 as well.

Once we address the linguistic/interpretivity considerations, we expect to meet our primary Q4 milestones of completing UI, finishing all necessary features, and having internal sign-off ready for a late-November roll-out.
